title: WCareer
shortDescription: AI-focused career platform combining MERN, Next.js interview tooling, and Python services for mock interviews and guidance.
description: WCareer is a multi-module platform that combines a MERN-style main app, a Next.js interview module, and Python-based AI services. The repository includes distinct client/server modules and an interview-specific frontend with Clerk/Drizzle integration.
myContributions: Designed a multi-module architecture spanning web app, interview module, and AI service layers.
Implemented authentication, data flows, and AI-assisted interview capabilities.
Built and documented the core product modules and integration points.
